name: weber
description: A portable IDE for TypeScript, Rust, C++ and Python — in your browser.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of a GitHub OAuth app with Device Flow enabled. Required for sign-in; without it the deployment is unauthenticated.

WEBER_ALLOWED_LOGINS.description: Comma-separated GitHub logins permitted to sign in. An empty list denies everyone. Required alongside GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.

WEBER_SESSION_SECRET.description: Secret used to sign session cookies, at least 16 characters. Generate with: head -c 32 /dev/urandom | base64

WORKSPACE_ROOT.description: Directory holding user projects. On an ephemeral filesystem this is wiped on every restart and deploy.

WEBER_SEED.description: Seed a starter workspace on first boot, so a new visitor sees something rather than an empty tree. Set to 0 to boot empty.

WEBER_SESSION_HOURS.description: How long a signed-in session lasts, in hours.
